rows.question: Where do I report an absence?
rows.answer:
To report a student absence at Vista Ridge High School, you have a few options:

- You can submit absence notes or medical documentation by email from the parent/guardian's email address on file to VRHSattendance@leanderisd.org.

If you have any other questions or need assistance in another language, you can connect with your student's assistant principal. Let me know if you need anything else!

rows.question: What is the student check-out policy?
rows.answer:
Here is the student check-out policy at Vista Ridge High School, based on the most recent information available for the 2026-2027 school year:

- **Parent/Guardian Presence Required:** To check a student out early, a parent or guardian must come to the front office in person, provide a photo ID, and check the student out.  
- **No Phone Calls:** Phone calls for early check-out are NOT accepted for student safety.
- **Advance Arrival:** Please arrive at least 20 minutes before you need your student to be released, due to the high volume of requests.
- **No Early Check-Outs After 2:45 pm:** In-person early check-outs after 2:45 pm will not be granted. After this time, students must wait for regular dismissal.
- **Student Sign-In/Out:** Students MUST sign in and out at the Attendance Window when leaving or returning to campus.
- **Documentation Required:** After your student’s absence, you must provide documentation (such as a note or email) including the student’s full legal name, ID#, grade, exact dismissal time, and reason for dismissal. This is necessary to excuse the absence and avoid truancy issues.
- **Email Option:** Emails sent before 10:30 AM can be used to check students out later in the day.

For full details and step-by-step instructions, you can visit: [How To Check Your Student Out Early](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/vrhsattendance/student-sign-out).

If you have any further questions, the front office can assist you at 512-570-1800.

Let me know if you need help with anything else!
sources: How To Check Your Student Out Early

rows.question: How do I appeal an attendance decision?
rows.answer:
To appeal an attendance decision at Vista Ridge High School—such as hours owed due to falling below 90% attendance—you should follow these steps based on the current school year information:

- Appeals can only be made for extenuating circumstances (for example, medical procedures or emergencies).
- You will need to contact your Assistant Principal to discuss your situation and request an Attendance Appeal Request Form.
- Supporting documentation (such as medical notes) is required for your appeal to be considered.
- The appeals committee will review your request and make a decision, which could include making up all, some, or none of the hours owed.

You can find your Assistant Principal’s contact information on the [Assistant Principals Office page](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/vrhs-assistant-principals-offi/home).

If you have any questions or need help starting the process, reaching out to your Assistant Principal is the best first step. Good luck!

rows.question: How do I register for AP tests?
rows.answer:
To register for AP tests at Vista Ridge High School for the 2026-2027 school year, you need to complete two main steps:

### 1. Register and Pay in Total Registration
- Go to the [Total Registration Link](https://user.totalregistration.net/AP/441176).
- Create an account (or log in if you already have one).
- Select your exams and pay the fee online ($85 per exam, or $27 per exam if you qualify for free/reduced lunch).
- Registration and payment are due by **October 28, 2026**. After this date, a $40 late fee per exam applies.

### 2. Join Your AP Class in College Board AP Classroom
- Go to [myap.collegeboard.org](https://myap.collegeboard.org/login) and log in or create an account.
- Use the join code provided by your AP teacher to enroll in each AP class section.
- Indicate whether you plan to take the AP exam (“YES” or “NO”) in AP Classroom. The default is “YES,” so change it if you are not taking the exam.

**Important:**  
Your AP exam registration is only complete once you have registered and paid in Total Registration **and** joined your course in AP Classroom.

For more details, you can view the [AP Test Registration Info](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/ap-test-registration) page or the [AP Registration Flyer](https://tinyurl.com/4cyzmnbh).

If you need help or want to cancel an exam, contact the campus Dean of Instruction, Olga Angelo-Day, at olga.angelo-day@leanderisd.org.

Good luck with your AP exams, Ranger!

rows.question: What do seniors need to do before graduation?
rows.answer:
Here are the main things Vista Ridge High School seniors (Class of 2027) need to do before graduation, based on the current information available:

- **Complete the FAFSA:** Filling out the FAFSA is a graduation requirement. The FAFSA opens October 1st, and the priority deadline for most Texas universities is January 15th. Check each university for their specific deadlines.
- **Order Cap and Gown:** The only required item for graduation is the Cap, Gown & Tassel Unit, which you order through Herff Jones. More information and order packets are provided during the senior meeting in October.
- **Clear All Obligations and Hours:** All school obligations and owed hours must be cleared before you can pick up your cap and gown.
- **Attend Graduation Practice:** Participation in graduation practice is required. Immediately after, there is a "Clap Out" event.
- **Senior Activities:** Participate in events like the Senior Panoramic Picture, Senior Awards (invitation only), Senior SAIL, and Project Graduation.
- **Elementary Graduation Walks:** Seniors can return to their LISD elementary school in cap and gown for a traditional walk. Transportation is not provided.
- **Google Account Transition:** After graduation, your school Google account will transition to an alumni account (alum.leanderisd.org) and remain active for one year. Download any files you want to keep to your personal computer.
- **Follow Cap Decorating Guidelines:** If you decorate your cap, follow the school’s guidelines to ensure it is appropriate for the ceremony.

For more details or updates, check the [Seniors 2027 page](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/seniors-2027) or contact the front office at 512-570-1800.

Let me know if you need information about a specific requirement or event!

You can report bullying at Vista Ridge High School by visiting the [Bullying Prevention](https://www.leanderisd.org/bullying) page. This page provides information on how to report bullying and the resources available for prevention and support.

If you need further assistance or have specific concerns, you can also contact the front office at 512-570-1800, and they can direct you to the appropriate staff member.

rows.question: Who do I contact about my schedule?
rows.answer:
For questions about your class schedule at Vista Ridge High School, the general guidance is to contact your counselor. Counselors handle schedule changes, course selections, and related concerns.

If you need help finding your counselor's contact information, you can check the [Staff Directory](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/directory) or call the front office at 512-570-1800 for assistance.

Let me know if you need help with anything else!

rows.question: How do I access my STAAR scores?
rows.answer:
You can access your STAAR scores online in two main ways:

### 1. Through the Home Access Center (HAC)
- Log into your LISD Home Access Center: [Home Access Center](https://www.leanderisd.org/homeaccess)
- Click on the "Grades" icon at the top.
- On the left, next to "Report Card," click on "Texas Test Scores."
- Your results will appear, or you’ll be directed to the Texas Student Portal.

### 2. Through the Texas Assessment Parent Portal
- Go to [texasassessment.gov](https://www.texasassessment.gov)
- Click "Log In to Parent Portal."
- Enter your child’s Unique Access Code and date of birth.
    - If you don’t know the access code, click "How do I find my access code?" and enter your child’s legal first name and TSDS ID (usually their social security number) to retrieve it.
- View and download your STAAR results.

### Need Help?
If you have trouble accessing your scores or have questions about your results, you can contact:
- Principal: Keith Morgan | 512-570-1810 | keith.morgan@leanderisd.org
- Campus Testing Coordinator: Linsey Cernero | 512-570-1823 | linsey.cernero@leanderisd.org

Let me know if you need instructions in Spanish or have any other questions!
